# Peptide Pen Research

> Pre-mixed, lab-tested research peptide pens with full COA documentation, cold-chain shipping and dosing references. For in-vitro laboratory use only.

Peptide Pen Research supplies research-grade peptide pens to laboratories. Every batch ships with HPLC-verified purity (≥99%), mass-spec identity confirmation, endotoxin/sterility screening, and temperature-monitored cold-chain delivery.
